n: Arduino Science Journal and Education kits (Engineering Kit)
t: Arduino learning kits by age band, including the Engineering Kit.
steps: Open the Arduino Education learning kits page.
Pick a kit that fits your students. Other kits include the Science Kit and Explore IoT Kit.
Confirm the price and availability with a seller.
Ask IT to install the Arduino IDE.
Check the account terms for the online tools.
Run the first project with a small group.
